turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how have you been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doing well, thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is taking the bus actually better for the environment than driving? Be honest.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Generally yes, especially when the bus is reasonably full. Per passenger, a busy bus produces far less pollution than everyone driving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, my dog won't sit still for a single photo. It's all blur.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Dogs are tough models. Do you want to try outdoors at the park where the light is bright, or indoors by a window with treats in your hand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Daniel for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, those trainers are bright orange.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I know. Aren't they amazing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You'll see them from space. Does Mum know you're spending your birthday money on traffic cones?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: She gave me the money, she doesn't get a vote.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fair. Do they at least fit?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: They're a bit tight at the toes, but they'll stretch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They won't. Ask the guy for the next size up, please.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine. But I'm still getting orange.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long has the kettle been boiling?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It just clicked off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, finished. I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, the dog. Outside in bright light, or inside with treats?
